package.note: ZIP smoke test used the same Release executable. Final packaging only refreshes docs. ZIP SHA-256 is in artifacts/package.json and the adjacent .sha256 file, outside the ZIP to avoid self-reference.

earlierAttempts: A sandbox DPAPI test failed due to user-context encryption; real-user Release and ASan runs passed.
ASan initially lacked its runtime DLL on PATH and failed to start (0xC0000135); configured MSVC runtime PATH and reran successfully.
Initial weather E2E detected an extra request when style-only changes rewrote legacy rounded coordinates; implementation was fixed and final suite passed.

Initial live Open-Meteo response returned HTTP 200 but WinHTTP automatic decompression aborted with 0x80004004 and an empty body. Disabled compression negotiation for this host; final native request and parser passed.
Package validation initially looked for a nonexistent root LICENSE instead of the installed licenses/nlohmann-json-MIT.txt; corrected the check and verified the actual third-party license.
limitations: Actual Windows logoff/logon was not performed; isolated registration, checkbox persistence, and execution of the registered command passed.
KMA real credentials and Google OAuth were not exercised. KMA HTTP fixture responses passed through the production parser.
Open-Meteo live result is one point-in-time request, not an availability or forecast accuracy guarantee.
Existing stress, long-duration performance, physical mouse drag and Win+D tests were not rerun for this change; earlier dated evidence remains separate.
Screenshots use isolated sample weather; they are not evidence of live weather values.
